name: subagent-team
description: Run coding work as a four-layer team: a director session, in-house expert and execution subagents, external agent teams (agy, Codex CLI and others) tracked by liaisons, independent read-only reviewers, a persistent team board, and resumable handover.

interface.shortDescription: Run coding work as a team of subagents and external CLI agents
interface.longDescription: A director session splits work and chooses each task's flow; in-house expert subagents design, review and accept; in-house execution subagents implement and test; external agent teams (agy, Codex CLI and others) take gated bulk work through low-tier liaisons; shared state lives on a team board in the repository; the human gets one batched question list at the end.
defaultPrompt: Use the subagent-team skill to plan and delegate this feature.
